thesis: Earnings 10/21 off a 52-week low, no dilution filed.
lesson: Price the event first. Options implied ±11.7%; my stop sat inside the noise and the target outside it. Killed before fill.

lesson: Filled at 15:40 ET Sunday exactly at the limit. A resting buy at a liquidity level got filled on the drift down, with no spread paid on top of the fill.

lesson: Cancelled unfilled: the extra coins would have sat outside the BTC stop. Re-place only when a check-in can resize the stop within hours.

thesis: Weakest major. Only buys a sweep under the 10/15 low and $100.

thesis: Strongest trend in crypto (+128% since August). Bought half at market and half on a −3.8% dip; both filled.
lesson: Stopped out 10/19 10:03 at $1,104 (−$0.15, −0.8%). The ratchet to near-breakeven worked: it turned a would-be −$1.30 into −$0.15. But a stop 6% under a coin that moves 5–10% a day gets hit by noise, so trail wider (~1.5× daily range) or take the target.
